memberdef.name: RuleIndexes

briefdescription.para: Maps a key to the indexes of the rules that have that key, in ascending order.

detaileddescription.para: The key is a literal tail of a path, a literal path, or an extension. A lookup by key needs no regex, so the rules that have a key are one hash lookup, not a scan.

briefdescription.para: Directory that the patterns of this link are relative to.
Relative prefix of the folder of this link, with a trailing slash, or empty.

detaileddescription.para: Paths outside it match nothing here.

briefdescription.para: The link of the enclosing rules file, which is consulted after this link.

detaileddescription.para: Null for the first link.

briefdescription.para: Every rule of this link, in file order.

detaileddescription.para: The indexes of the containers below point into it.

briefdescription.para: Rules whose pattern is a literal name, such as build, or a literal after a leading **, such as **/Builds/x64.

detaileddescription.para: Keyed by that literal. Such a rule applies to an entry at any depth, so getLastMatch looks up every tail of the path that starts at a folder boundary. A walk needs no expression for these rules.

briefdescription.para: Rules whose pattern is an anchored literal path, such as /docs/build.

detaileddescription.para: Keyed by that path.

briefdescription.para: Rules whose pattern is an extension, such as *.o, or ** followed by *.o.

detaileddescription.para: Keyed by the extension without the dot.

briefdescription.para: Indexes of the rules whose pattern needs a regex, in ascending order.

detaileddescription.para: The search starts from the last one.

memberdef.name: IgnoreRules

briefdescription.para: Creates one link of the rules chain.

parameterdescription.para: The link of the enclosing rules file, or null for the first link.
The directory that the patterns of this link are relative to.
The relative prefix that the patterns of this link carry, with a trailing slash, or empty.

briefdescription.para: Returns a slash-terminated path prefix for rootDirectory relative to the ignore root.

parameterdescription.para: Traversal root directory.

simplesect.para: Relative prefix ending in '/', or empty when rootDirectory is the top level.

briefdescription.para: Tests whether an entry is excluded by the loaded ignore rules.

detaileddescription.para: The nearest link with a matching rule decides. Inside one link, the last matching rule wins, so a negated pattern overrides an earlier match.

parameterdescription.para: Entry path relative to the ignore top level using '/' separators.
True when the candidate entry is a directory.

simplesect.para: True when the winning rule is not negated. False when no rule matches.

briefdescription.para: Creates the rules chain that applies to a walk.

detaileddescription.para: The chain is built in this order. The global excludes file comes first, as the first link. The repository exclude file comes next, as a link, when it exists. Then the .gitignore of each directory from the top level down to the walk root is added as a link, when it exists.

parameterdescription.para: The directory where the walk starts.

simplesect.para: The last link of the chain.

memberdef.name: getChildRules

briefdescription.para: Creates the link for the .gitignore of a directory, on top of the parent rules.

detaileddescription.para: The new link points to parentRules, so no rule is copied.

parameterdescription.para: The rules of the enclosing directory.
The directory whose .gitignore is read.
The path of the directory relative to the top level. Empty for the top level.

briefdescription.para: Returns the top level of the repository that holds a walk root.

detaileddescription.para: The top level is the nearest directory, from walkRoot upward, that holds a .git entry. When no directory holds one, walkRoot is the top level.

parameterdescription.para: The directory where the walk starts.

briefdescription.para: Adds the .gitignore link of each directory from the top level down to a directory.

detaileddescription.para: The recursion visits the ancestors of the directory first, so the links are added from the top level downward. A directory without a .gitignore adds no link.

parameterdescription.para: The rules chain that the links are added on top of.
The walk root, or an ancestor of it.

simplesect.para: The chain with the new links, or parentRules when no directory has a .gitignore.

briefdescription.para: Returns the global excludes file that git would use.

detaileddescription.para: The core.excludesFile value of the XDG git config file names the file. The user git config file takes precedence when it sets the value. A value that starts with the home prefix is relative to the home folder. Any other value is relative to the working folder. Without a value, the XDG ignore file is returned, or the ignore file of the home folder when no XDG home is set.

simplesect.para: The file. The file may not exist.

briefdescription.para: Reads the core.excludesFile value from one git config file.

detaileddescription.para: A file that does not exist, cannot be read, or holds binary bytes gives an empty value.

parameterdescription.para: The git config file to read.

simplesect.para: The value, or an empty string when none is set.

memberdef.name: getLinkedRules

briefdescription.para: Creates one link of the rules chain, with the rules of one file.

detaileddescription.para: The new link points to parentRules, so no rule is copied. A file that does not exist gives a link with no rules.

parameterdescription.para: The link that the new link sits on. Null for the first link.
The rules file to read.
The directory that the patterns of the new link are relative to.
The prefix that the patterns carry, with a trailing slash, or empty.

briefdescription.para: Translates one glob pattern of a rules file into a regular expression.

detaileddescription.para: An anchored pattern matches from the start of the relative path. A floating pattern matches after any slash. A leading ** that is followed by a slash matches any number of folders. Each other glob step is translated by appendGlobStep. The expression ends at the end of the path.

parameterdescription.para: The pattern, without its negation mark, directory marker, and anchor.
True to anchor the pattern at the top level.

briefdescription.para: Adds the rules of each line of a rules file to this link.

detaileddescription.para: A file that does not exist, cannot be read, or holds binary bytes adds no rule.

parameterdescription.para: The rules file to read.

briefdescription.para: Adds one rule from one line of a rules file, in the family that its pattern selects.

detaileddescription.para: A literal name, or a literal after a leading folder wildcard **, goes to suffixes. An anchored literal path goes to relativePaths. An extension, with or without a leading folder wildcard, goes to extensions. Any other glob goes to others. A glob that does not compile adds no rule. A line without a pattern adds no rule.

parameterdescription.para: The line of the rules file, without its line ending.

briefdescription.para: Returns the index of the last rule of this link that matches the entry.

detaileddescription.para: The rules are looked up by key first: the literal tails of the path at each folder boundary, the literal path, and the extension. Then the regex rules that come after the best key match are tested, from the last one backward. A path outside basePrefix matches no rule of this link.

parameterdescription.para: Entry path relative to the ignore top level using '/' separators.
True when the entry is a directory.

simplesect.para: The index of the last matching rule, or -1 when no rule of this link matches.

memberdef.argsstring: (const RuleIndexes &indexes, std::string_view key, bool isDirectory) const
memberdef.name: getLastIndex

briefdescription.para: Returns the index of the last rule of a key that applies to the entry type.

detaileddescription.para: A directory-only rule applies to a directory only, so it is skipped for any other entry.

parameterdescription.para: The key map to search: suffixes, relativePaths, or extensions.
The literal key to look up.
True when the entry is a directory.

simplesect.para: The index of the last rule of the key that applies, or -1 when none applies.

briefdescription.para: Evaluates hierarchical .gitignore, repository exclude, and global exclude rules.

detaileddescription.para: The rules form a chain of links. Each link holds the rules of one file and points to its parent link. A child directory therefore copies none of the rules of its parents.
